title: Sharp Transported Effects When the Target Releases Only Overlapping Score Intervals
banked_reason: D0.5.G delivered tier incremental below novelty floor field and found the finite known-population-law LP intersection NOT salvageable in scope; decision referee returned revise with two unresolved findings.
gap_reasons: What is proved is an exact finite-dimensional LP characterization for a specialized intersection of an interval-selection polytope and a bounded isotonic-ratio polytope, rather than a broadly new random-set or order-cone framework.

The package supplies no sampling theory for estimated p, m, and tau, no uncertainty treatment near compatibility boundaries or nonunique endpoint faces, and no empirical or reproducible software evidence establishing practical importance.
Panel findings left unrepaired (the tier, not these, is the reason for the halt): related_work_incomplete@thm:sharp-endpoints, counterexample_nondegeneracy@thm:one-shot-projection-fails.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived finite known-population-law compatibility, sharp endpoint, refinement, and certificate results, including a six-master-LP construction. The math referee passed cited claims after source attestation, but the decision referee returned revise with two findings unresolved. The field-tier program would require uniform sampling inference near tied LP faces and compatibility boundaries, or a specialized algorithm/lower bound beyond generic LP.
tldr: A randomized trial identifies score-cell effects, while the target population releases only overlapping intervals containing an ordered target-likeness score. The project characterizes compatibility through a normalized separation margin whose full and at-most-\(K\) laminar suprema coincide, derives sharp transported-effect endpoints with allocation and PAVA-threshold equality certificates, identifies exactly which split masses preserve an effect endpoint, and gives a degeneracy-safe exact-rational implementation. One unanchored cube linear program computes the compatibility margin; subtracting the optimizer's minimum yields the normalized laminar certificate without changing its value. Together with at most three composition programs and two endpoint-dual programs, the construction uses at most six master linear programs, plus at most three flow recoveries, and has polynomial bit complexity. Sharp endpoints and causal attainment are proved by the sharp-endpoint theorem; only a specialized speedup-or-obstruction beyond generic rational linear programming remains open. A fully specified four-cell one-shot projection surrogate differs from the exact jointly dualized program by \(1/10\), and the gap persists on an admissible open neighborhood. Generic random-set selection, linear-program duality, and weighted isotonic projection are credited ingredients.
gap: Random-set methods characterize unrestricted selections from interval observations, isotonic distributional robustness evaluates ordered density-ratio support, and causal transport methods use exact target summaries. None of the inspected results characterizes their intersection for overlapping target interval releases or the effect-specific value of splitting a release.
fill: The project supplies an if-and-only-if normalized laminar compatibility certificate, exact sharp causal endpoints with allocations in \(\mathcal X(q,m)\) and explicit PAVA-threshold equality conditions, a robust counterexample to one-shot projection, and a necessary-and-sufficient endpoint-face criterion for disclosure refinement, while leaving improved certificate complexity as an explicit open question.
